about: Blocks that fall (gravity) on RotN 3.3.4, from bytecode. `blocks` lists every dumped block that falls: via "BlockFalling" (its class extends net.minecraft.block.BlockFalling), "own-code" (its class makes an EntityFallingBlock itself; reviewed, with the condition in `when`) "contenttweaker-gravity" (a ContentTweaker block a pack script gives gravity, cited by line) or "osv-background" (an Ore Stone Variants ore on a BlockFalling background, with bgImitation on). Any other dumped block does not fall. Built by tools/build-falling-blocks.mjs from the pinned server pack zip; see that file for the method and what is not reflected.

source.srg: forge-1.12.2-14.23.5.2860.jar!/deobfuscation_data-1.12.2.lzma (notch to SRG; maps minecraft_server.1.12.2.jar and forge-1.12.2-14.23.5.2860.jar)

betterwithaddons:chandelier.evidence: Better With Addons-0.51.jar: BlockChandelier.updateTick (func_180650_b, bytecode 3) and neighborChanged (func_189540_a, 14) call checkAndDrop, which spawns an EntityFallingBlock (43-76) on the server when canBlockStay is false (10-13)

charm:gold_lantern.evidence: Charm-1.12.2-1.4.1.jar: BlockLantern.updateTick (func_180650_b, bytecode 9) calls its private checkFallable, which returns early while the lantern can stay (the HANGING property with canPlaceBelow / canPlaceAbove, 5-47) and otherwise falls like sand (isAirBlock / BlockFalling.canFallThrough 53-70, new EntityFallingBlock 127)

charm:iron_lantern.evidence: Charm-1.12.2-1.4.1.jar: BlockLantern.updateTick (func_180650_b, bytecode 9) calls its private checkFallable, which returns early while the lantern can stay (the HANGING property with canPlaceBelow / canPlaceAbove, 5-47) and otherwise falls like sand (isAirBlock / BlockFalling.canFallThrough 53-70, new EntityFallingBlock 127)

dynamictreesphc:fruitalmond.evidence: DynamicTreesPHC-1.12.2-2.0.6.jar: BlockPamFruit.updateTick (func_180650_b, bytecode 53) and neighborChanged (func_189540_a, 48) call its private blockFall, which returns when distanceFromPlayerToFall is 0, needs a player within that distance unless it is -1 (World.getClosestPlayer, 9-43), and the block below to be air (World.isAirBlock, 49-52); it then spawns BlockPamFruit$1, an EntityFallingBlock subclass (113-144). The pack: config/dynamictreesphc.cfg line 5 S:fallingFruitFallChance=10, whose comment (line 4) describes it as that distance (default 10; 0 disables). Which field the key loads into was not traced
